senses.definition: a medicine or therapy that cures disease or relieve pain

quotations.old_english: Hér ys seó bót, hú ðú meaht ðíne æceras bétan
quotations.english: here is the remedy, how thou mayest improve shy fields

quotations.old_english: Findest ðú ðǽr æt bóte and ælteowe hǽlo
quotations.english: thou shalt find therein a remedy and perfect healing
